title: Portfolio Website Services Section
description: A responsive services section with static website, responsive design, and custom layout cards.

services.title: Static Websites
services.description: A static website contains web pages with fixed content. Each page is developed using HTML and CSS and displays the same information to every visitor.

services.title: Responsive Web design
services.description: Responsive web design suggests that design and development should respond to the user’s behaviour and environment based on screen size, platform and orientation.

services.title: Customisable Layouts
services.description: Customisable sites are templates with set layouts. You can change photos and colours, while the layout provides a consistent starting point.
